Happy Anniversary Sayang

I wish I was your joke, so I could make you laugh.
I wish I was your poem, so I could make you deep.
In a room full of noise, your voice is the only thing I hear.
You don't have to change a thing, you're perfect as you are.
You make me feel like I am home.
Thank you for loving me when I couldn't even love myself.
You are my best friend, my lover, and my life.
And if the world is ending, I'd wanna be with you.
Cause I'll keep on loving you, Till the end of time.
